states.failed: applies and not met, 0 points, stays in denominator
states.unobservable: could not be verified from outside, points removed from denominator
states.not_applicable: page type does not exist on this site, points removed from denominator

rounding: proportional checks use floor(points * meeting / total); never round up
banding: read the band from score / observable_max * 100

checks.name: AI crawlers allowed in robots.txt
checks.pass: The retrieval user-agents are not disallowed. floor(3 × allowed / 10) — see ai-crawlers.md. Opt-out tokens and training crawlers are not counted

checks.name: Retrieval crawlers actually reachable
checks.pass: Requesting the homepage with each retrieval user-agent returns **200 with the real page** — not 403, not a challenge page, not a JS interstitial. floor(3 × reachable / 10)

checks.name: llms.txt present and complete
checks.pass: Resolves at /llms.txt, valid Markdown, has an H1, a summary blockquote, and ≥3 sectioned link groups

checks.name: llms-full.txt present
checks.pass: Resolves and is substantially longer than llms.txt

checks.name: ai.txt policy file
checks.pass: Resolves at /ai.txt

checks.name: Sitemap completeness
checks.pass: sitemap.xml resolves, is referenced from robots.txt, covers all indexable locales

checks.name: GEO <link> tags in <head>
checks.pass: rel="llms", rel="llms-full", or rel="ai-policy" present

checks.name: Content in server-rendered HTML
checks.pass: Fetching without executing JavaScript returns the page's primary content

checks.name: Organization + WebSite sitewide
checks.pass: Valid JSON-LD on every indexable page

checks.name: Article/BlogPosting with author
checks.pass: Present on article pages, with a named author that has a resolvable identity

checks.name: FAQPage on Q&A pages
checks.pass: Present wherever the page is structured as questions

checks.name: speakable coverage
checks.pass: Declared on pages with a clear answer passage

checks.name: Product/Offer on commercial pages
checks.pass: Present on pricing or product pages

checks.name: HowTo / BreadcrumbList
checks.pass: Present where the page is a procedure or sits in a hierarchy

checks.name: Answer passages on key pages
checks.pass: Each key page opens its main section with a self-contained 40–90 word passage that answers the page's question without needing surrounding context

checks.name: Statistics carry a source
checks.pass: Numeric claims are attributed to a named, linkable source

checks.name: Named expert authorship
checks.pass: Author is a real, identifiable person with a bio, not "admin" or a brand name

checks.name: Questions match natural phrasing
checks.pass: Headings are phrased the way a person would ask an assistant, not as keyword strings

checks.name: Freshness signals
checks.pass: dateModified present and within the last 180 days on evergreen pages

checks.name: Knowledge-graph presence
checks.pass: A Wikidata item or equivalent authority record exists and is referenced via sameAs

checks.name: Third-party listings
checks.pass: Present on at least one independent review or directory site

checks.name: Video presence
checks.pass: A channel with published content exists and is linked via sameAs

checks.name: Independent mentions
checks.pass: The brand is discussed on sites you do not control

checks.name: sameAs links resolve
checks.pass: Every sameAs URL returns 200 and the destination references the brand back

checks.name: Search Console verified
checks.pass: Property verified

checks.name: Bing Webmaster submitted
checks.pass: Site submitted and indexed

checks.name: Cited in a multi-engine query test
checks.pass: A fixed set of ≥10 buyer-intent queries is run against ≥3 engines. Score floor(3 × engines-where-cited / 3). Running the test but never being cited scores **0** — this check measures the outcome, not the procedure

checks.name: Answer-shape fit
checks.pass: Content length and structure match how the target engines format answers

checks.name: Non-English engine coverage
checks.pass: If the audience is non-English, the corresponding regional engines were tested
